sharedLockSpan: before first stage until all owned quiet and final restoration verified
ownership: exact inherited stage token, PID/start, verified parent/session/adopted chain, Linux subreaper and pidfd; never name-based/global kill
allowedRestoredCtimePaths: only emit-reveal parent-qualified actual journal subset; unchanged paths never touch or repair
journalFailurePolicy: trusted intent may support uncertain restore; missing/untrusted intent does not; preserve failure and stop
